name: Cosmic Blast
description: This paint is full of surprises, just like space. Maybe there's more to this paint than just an explosion. If you look closer, you will notice one or two planets that may seem familiar to you.
interestingFacts: The paint was obtainable by reaching the 45th tier of February 2020 challenge
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.
